title.ko: 피드백: constructive criticism · I'd suggest · One area for improvement is
title.en: giving and receiving feedback: constructive criticism, I'd suggest, one area for improvement is

explain.ko: 건설적인 피드백은 구체적이고 균형 잡혀 있으며 행동에 초점을 둡니다. 보통 강점(What went well was ...)으로 시작해 개선점(One area for improvement is ...)을 말하고 제안(I'd suggest ..., How about ...?)으로 마무리합니다. 받는 입장에서는 방어적이 되지 말고 구체적인 예를 요청(Could you give me an example?)하며 의견을 받아들이겠다는 의사(I'll take that on board)를 표현합니다. 완곡한 표현은 비판을 부드럽게 만듭니다.
explain.en: Constructive feedback is specific, balanced and focused on behaviour. It usually starts with strengths (What went well was ...), names an area for improvement (One area for improvement is ...) and ends with a suggestion (I'd suggest ..., How about ...?). Receivers should avoid becoming defensive, ask for examples (Could you give me an example?) and signal acceptance (I'll take that on board). Tentative phrasing softens criticism.

items.passage:
ADVICE
How to receive feedback
It is easy to become defensive on receiving feedback. But don't take criticism as a personal attack; see it as an opportunity to grow. Ask for specific examples where unclear, and summarise what you heard to check.

trans.ko:

prompt.ko: 동료나 학생에게 피드백을 장점·개선점·제안·격려 순으로 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences of feedback to a colleague or student: strength, area for improvement, suggestion, encouragement.

task.model: The greatest strength of your presentation was its logical structure. One area for improvement is that the pace was rather fast. I'd suggest speaking more slowly and pausing in the middle. You've made noticeable progress since last month, so be confident.

model_trans.ko: 발표의 가장 큰 강점은 논리적인 구성이었습니다. 개선할 점은 속도가 다소 빨랐다는 것입니다. 조금 더 천천히 말하고 중간에 쉬어 보면 좋겠습니다. 지난달보다 눈에 띄게 발전했으니 자신감을 가지세요.
model_trans.en: The greatest strength of your presentation was its logical structure. One area for improvement is that the pace was rather fast. I'd suggest speaking more slowly and pausing in the middle. You've made noticeable progress since last month, so be confident.
